model.license: Apache-2.0 subject to gpt-oss usage policy
model.role_in_ramp: open-weight target model for span embeddings and activation probe research

runtime.why_not_vllm_for_extraction: RAMP needs hidden states and activation hooks; OpenAI-compatible serving APIs are not the source of record for internal representations.

extraction.tokenization: model tokenizer with chat/template disabled for isolated spans unless the experiment explicitly tests chat context
extraction.hidden_state_layer_policy: use final transformer hidden state as centroid v0 default; persist all selected layer IDs in extraction metadata
extraction.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling over non-padding tokens
extraction.normalization: l2_normalize pooled vector before centroid construction
extraction.batching: batch spans by token length and record batch size in metadata
extraction.precision: bfloat16 preferred on supported GPUs; record actual dtype
extraction.randomness: disable sampling; set deterministic seeds where framework support allows

centroid_build.centroid_method_v0: mean of normalized span vectors per domain/subcluster_role/subcluster_id, followed by l2 normalization
centroid_build.heldout_policy: hold out benchmark source splits or source families before threshold calibration

activation_probe.relationship_to_embedding_source: use the same model checkout and tokenizer as the embedding source
activation_probe.probe_inputs: same span corpus plus session-composed examples
activation_probe.metadata_requirement: store layer IDs, hook names, tensor shapes, dtype, model revision, and tokenizer revision

runpod.recommended_first_gpu: single A100 80GB or H100 class GPU for comfortable extraction experiments
runpod.budget_gpu_option: single 48GB GPU may be viable with quantization/offloading, but is not the frozen reference environment
runpod.recommended_template: RunPod PyTorch/Jupyter pod or custom CUDA image with Transformers
